title: SecReason: Vulnerability Detection and In-Stream Self-Repair for LLM Code Generation
title_zh: SecReason：面向 LLM 代码生成的漏洞检测与流式自修复

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) may introduce security vulnerabilities into generated code, which can persist into production when verification focuses on functional correctness. Existing defenses act before, during, or after generation, but none inspects the code during generation. Security prompts and retrieved security knowledge act before any code exists, constrained decoding limits token choices but cannot guide repair, and post-hoc repair must regenerate the full response. Reasoning LLMs draft code early in their streamed chain of thought, and in this pre-delivery window the code exists only inside the reasoning stream. We present SecReason , an in-stream defense that monitors this window. Dual-track incremental scanning applies security rules, checking each statement as it is emitted and tracing dataflows across the accumulated code. When a security rule fires, SecReason interrupts generation, inserts an in-stream warning, and resumes decoding, so the model repairs the draft within the same reasoning trace without regenerating the full response. On tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, SecReason raises the share of runs delivering secure and functionally correct code from below 15% to 72.8%–98.1% on CWEval and SecCodeBench . SecReason consumes fewer tokens than post-hoc repair, and when security rules misfire on secure code, it limits the functional regressions from false warnings.

paragraphs.en: Developers increasingly delegate implementation tasks to code assistants and coding agents built on large language models (LLMs), but the generated code can introduce security vulnerabilities such as injection and weak cryptography ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Ramírez et al., 2025 ) . Because developers primarily verify functionality and rarely screen for security, they tend to trust code that executes correctly ( Perry et al., 2023 ; Khalid et al., 2027 ) , so functionally correct but vulnerable code persists in software repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者越来越多地将实现任务委托给基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的代码助手和编码智能体，但生成的代码可能会引入注入和弱加密等安全漏洞（Pearce 等人，2022；Fu 等人，2025；Ramírez 等人，2025）。 由于开发者主要验证功能而很少检查安全性，他们倾向于信任能够正确运行的代码（Perry 等人，2023；Khalid 等人，2027），因此功能正确但存在漏洞的代码仍会存在于软件仓库中。

paragraphs.en: Existing defenses act before, during, or after generation, but none inspects the code during generation. Security fine-tuning ( He et al., 2024 ) and security prompts ( Sajadi et al., 2025 ) act before any code exists, so they cannot verify whether the output is secure or guide the model toward safe alternatives. Constrained decoding methods act during generation, enforcing grammar ( Ugare et al., 2025 ) , conditioning on execution feedback ( Lavon et al., 2025 ) , or blocking completions matching known weakness patterns ( Storhaug et al., 2023 ) , but none can guide the model to repair its code. Post-generation defenses, such as static scanners ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) and automated program repair ( Pearce et al., 2023 ; Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , inspect code precisely but only after generation completes. Repairing a vulnerability then requires regenerating the full response, which increases token consumption and risks breaking working code.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的防御机制在生成前、生成中或生成后发挥作用，但没有一种能在生成过程中检查代码。 安全微调（He 等人，2024）和安全提示（Sajadi 等人，2025）在任何代码生成之前就已介入，因此它们无法验证输出是否安全，也无法引导模型选择更安全的替代方案。 受约束的解码方法在生成过程中发挥作用，包括强制遵循语法规则（Ugare 等人，2025）、基于执行反馈进行条件调整（Lavon 等人，2025），或阻止与已知漏洞模式匹配的补全结果（Storhaug 等人，2023），但没有一种方法能引导模型修复其代码。 生成后的防御机制，例如静态扫描器（Sun 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025）和自动化程序修复工具（Pearce 等人，2023；Alrashedy 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2026），虽然能精确检查代码，但只能在生成完成后才能执行。 修复漏洞后需要重新生成整个响应，这会增加令牌消耗量，并可能破坏原本正常运行的代码。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning LLMs ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) make the code inspectable during generation. Before producing a final answer, these models emit an extended chain of thought ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , and as our empirical analysis shows (Section 2.2 ), they typically draft implementations early in this trace. Security concerns do appear in this reasoning, but they do not prevent vulnerable drafts from passing into the delivered code. The interval between drafting and delivery is a pre-delivery window. The draft is already accessible in the token stream while generation is still underway. Running static analysis on the stream allows defenses to detect vulnerabilities and insert diagnostic feedback into the reasoning trace, so the model can repair them in place before delivery, without regenerating the full response.
paragraphs.zh: 推理型大语言模型（OpenAI，2024；Google DeepMind，2025；Guo 等，2025）使得代码在生成过程中可以被检查。 在生成最终答案之前，这些模型会输出一个扩展的思考链（Wei 等，2022），正如我们的实证分析所示（第 2.2 节），它们通常会在这一思考过程的早期阶段草拟实现方案。 安全性问题确实出现在这种推理过程中，但这并未阻止存在漏洞的草案进入最终交付的代码中。 草拟与交付之间的时间间隔是一个交付前窗口。 在生成仍在进行的过程中，草案就已经可以在令牌流中访问了。 对令牌流执行静态分析，可以让防御机制检测出漏洞，并将诊断反馈插入到推理痕迹中，这样模型就能在交付前原地修复这些漏洞，而无需重新生成整个响应。

sents.zh: 草拟与交付之间的时间间隔是一个交付前窗口。

sents.zh: 在生成仍在进行的过程中，草案就已经可以在令牌流中访问了。

sents.en: Running static analysis on the stream allows defenses to detect vulnerabilities and insert diagnostic feedback into the reasoning trace, so the model can repair them in place before delivery, without regenerating the full response.
sents.zh: 对令牌流执行静态分析，可以让防御机制检测出漏洞，并将诊断反馈插入到推理痕迹中，这样模型就能在交付前原地修复这些漏洞，而无需重新生成整个响应。

paragraphs.en: Applying static analysis to these streams is not straightforward. Static analyzers expect complete, syntactically valid files, whereas reasoning streams interleave partial code with natural-language text. An in-stream defense must therefore recognize statements as they complete and translate structured analyzer findings into feedback that the model can act on within the ongoing trace.
paragraphs.zh: 对这些流应用静态分析并非易事。 静态分析器需要完整且语法正确的文件，而推理流则将部分代码与自然语言文本交错呈现。 因此，流内防御必须能在语句完成时识别它们，并将结构化分析器的发现转化为模型能够在此持续追踪过程中采取行动的反馈。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present SecReason , an in-stream defense system that intercepts vulnerable code drafts during reasoning and guides the model to repair them before delivery. Operating at the inference serving layer without modifying model weights, SecReason monitors code blocks within the streaming reasoning trace and parses tokens incrementally to recognize completed statements. To balance latency against detection depth, it scans a security ruleset on two tracks. A statement-local track checks each completed statement as it is emitted, and a context-dependent track catches dataflows spanning the accumulated code. When a security rule fires, SecReason interrupts generation and inserts an in-stream warning into the token stream. The model then repairs the draft within the ongoing reasoning trace, delivering secure code without full-response regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SecReason——一种流式防御系统，它能在推理过程中拦截脆弱的代码草案，并在交付前引导模型进行修复。 SecReason 在推理服务层运行而无需修改模型权重，它能监控流式推理轨迹中的代码块，并逐步解析词元以识别已完成的语句。 为了在延迟与检测深度之间取得平衡，该系统会沿着两条路径扫描安全规则集。 一条语句级路径会在每个语句生成时立即检查；另一条上下文依赖路径则能捕捉到贯穿已积累代码的数据流。 当某条安全规则被触发时，SecReason 会中断生成过程，并在词元流中插入一个流式警告。 随后，模型会在当前的推理轨迹内修复代码草案，从而无需重新生成完整响应即可交付安全的代码。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SecReason on two benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , spanning 173 tasks in five programming languages, across six reasoning models for streaming detection and two locally deployed models for in-stream self-repair. On tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, SecReason raises the share of runs delivering secure and functionally correct code from below 15 % 15\% to 72.8 % 72.8\% – 98.1 % 98.1\% across the two self-repair models and both benchmarks. These gains come at lower token cost than post-hoc repair, and with smaller functional regressions when security rules misfire on secure code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个基准数据集上对 SecReason 进行了评估，即 CWEval（Peng 等人，2025）和 SecCodeBench（Chen 等人，2026），这些数据集涵盖了五种编程语言中的 173 项任务，涉及用于流式检测的六种推理模型以及用于流内自我修复的两个本地部署模型。 在那些未经辅助生成便会引入漏洞的任务中，SecReason 将能够生成安全且功能正确的代码的运行比例从低于 15%（15\%）提升至 72.8%（72.8\%）至 98.1%（98.1\%），这一结果涵盖了两种自我修复模型和两个基准数据集。 这些改进不仅比事后修复的令牌成本更低，而且当安全规则错误地应用于安全代码时，功能退化也更小。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献。

paragraphs.en: We conduct an empirical study across six reasoning models and 173 tasks. We find that models write complete implementations early in the reasoning stream, but neither their security-term mentions nor their unassisted self-review reliably prevents insecure delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在六个推理模型和 173 项任务上开展了一项实证研究。 我们发现，模型在推理流程的早期阶段就会编写完整的实现代码，但无论是其安全术语的提及，还是未经辅助的自我审查，都无法可靠地防止不安全结果的输出。

sents.en: We conduct an empirical study across six reasoning models and 173 tasks.
sents.zh: 我们在六个推理模型和 173 项任务上开展了一项实证研究。

sents.en: We find that models write complete implementations early in the reasoning stream, but neither their security-term mentions nor their unassisted self-review reliably prevents insecure delivery.
sents.zh: 我们发现，模型在推理流程的早期阶段就会编写完整的实现代码，但无论是其安全术语的提及，还是未经辅助的自我审查，都无法可靠地防止不安全结果的输出。

paragraphs.en: We design and implement SecReason to intercept vulnerable code drafts during reasoning and guide the model to repair them before delivery. SecReason parses tokens incrementally to recognize completed statements, pairs statement-local checks with context-dependent scans for dataflows, and inserts in-stream warnings that prompt self-repair within the ongoing trace.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计并实现了 SecReason，用于在推理过程中拦截存在漏洞的代码草案，并在交付前引导模型进行修复。 SecReason 通过增量解析词元来识别完整的语句，将语句内部的检查与依赖上下文的流数据扫描相结合，并在当前执行流程中插入即时警告，以促使其自我修复。

sents.en: SecReason parses tokens incrementally to recognize completed statements, pairs statement-local checks with context-dependent scans for dataflows, and inserts in-stream warnings that prompt self-repair within the ongoing trace.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SecReason on CWEval and SecCodeBench , across six reasoning models for streaming detection and two locally deployed models for in-stream self-repair. On tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, in-stream self-repair delivers secure and functionally correct code in 72.8 % 72.8\% – 98.1 % 98.1\% of runs, up from below 15 % 15\% under unassisted generation, for fewer tokens than post-hoc repair requires.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 CWEval 和 SecCodeBench 上对 SecReason 进行了评估，涉及用于流式检测的六种推理模型以及用于流内自我修复的两个本地部署模型。 在未经辅助生成会引入漏洞的任务中，流内自我修复在 72.8%–98.1% 的运行中能够生成安全且功能正确的代码，这一比例远高于未辅助生成时的不足 15%，并且所需的令牌数量少于事后修复。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning models (e.g., the GPT , Qwen , and GLM families) reason ( Wei et al., 2022 ) by default when generating code, and some (such as GLM - 5.3 ) offer no option to disable it. Figure 1 shows a reasoning trace of Qwen3 .6 - 35 B - A3B on a URL generation task. Prompted to build a URL from a trusted domain and a user-supplied subdomain prefix, the model streams its reasoning before delivering the final code. During this trace, the model interleaves natural-language reasoning with drafted code, evaluating edge cases for “empty or invalid” input before writing a preliminary implementation inside a markdown code fence. After the fenced block, the model reviews the draft and concludes that the validation is sufficient (e.g., “This covers empty…”). Finally, the model delivers this drafted code as its final response, unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 推理模型（例如 GPT、Qwen 和 GLM 系列）在生成代码时默认会进行推理（Wei et al., 2022），其中一些模型（如 GLM-5.3）甚至不提供禁用该功能的选项。 图 1 展示了 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在执行 URL 生成任务时的推理过程。 当被要求基于一个可信域和用户提供的前缀子域名构建 URL 时，该模型会在输出最终代码之前先逐步呈现其推理过程。 在此推理过程中，模型将自然语言推理与草拟的代码交替呈现，并在编写 Markdown 代码围栏内的初步实现之前，评估了“空输入或无效输入”等边界情况。 在代码围栏块之后，模型审查了草案并得出结论：验证是充分的（例如，“这涵盖了空输入的情况……”）。 最后，模型将这份草拟的代码原封不动地作为最终响应输出。

paragraphs.en: However, the delivered code is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF, CWE-918 in the Common Weakness Enumeration). Earlier in the same trace, before drafting the implementation, the model had explicitly identified # and ? as characters that render the prefix invalid, but the drafted validation checks only for slashes and empty strings. Because # and ? begin the fragment or query component in URL syntax, they terminate the host. A payload such as evil . com # bypasses the check and directs requests to the untrusted evil . com domain. In this trace, unassisted self-review provides no diagnostic feedback on the drafted validation. Re-reading the draft does not bring back the # and ? cases that the model’s earlier reasoning had identified.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，交付的代码存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF，常见弱点枚举中的 CWE-918）漏洞。 在此追踪记录的前述阶段，在编写实现代码之前，该模型已明确指出 # 和 ? 会使前缀无效，但草拟的验证检查仅检测斜杠和空字符串。 由于 # 和 ? 在 URL 语法中位于片段或查询组件的开头，因此它们会终止主机部分的解析。 像 evil . com # 这样的有效载荷会绕过该检查，并将请求重定向到不可信的 evil . com 域名。 在此追踪记录中，无辅助的自我审查未对草拟的验证逻辑提供任何诊断反馈。 重新阅读草案时，模型并未回想起其早期推理中已识别出的 # 和 ? 的情况。

paragraphs.en: While this motivating example illustrates that unassisted self-review can fail on an individual task, a single trace cannot answer how often models deliver insecure code, how often their reasoning mentions security, and how early code drafts form. We ask three questions: (1) how frequently models leave vulnerabilities in delivered code, (2) how often their reasoning mentions security terms, and (3) how early they draft code in their reasoning traces.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然这个激励性示例表明，在没有辅助的情况下，自我审查可能会在单个任务中失败，但仅凭一条轨迹无法回答模型产生不安全代码的频率、其推理过程提及安全的频率，以及代码草案形成的时间早晚。 我们提出三个问题：（1）模型在交付的代码中留下漏洞的频率有多高；（2）其推理过程提及安全术语的频率有多高；以及（3）它们在推理轨迹中多早开始起草代码。

paragraphs.en: To examine these questions, we evaluate six open-weight models that expose complete reasoning streams, Qwen3 .6 - 35 B - A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Gemma - 4 - 26 B - A4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , DeepSeek - V4 - Flash ( DeepSeek AI, 2026 ) , MiniMax - M3 ( MiniMaxAI, 2026 ) , GLM - 5.3 - Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , and Kimi - K3 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) . Closed APIs such as GPT and Gemini are excluded because they return only thought summaries ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Google, 2026 ) . We evaluate these models on two code generation benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . We include every task written in Python, JavaScript, Java, C, or C++. This yields 173 tasks in total, 97 from CWEval and 76 from SecCodeBench . To evaluate the delivered code, we execute each benchmark’s functional and security test suites, labeling a generation as insecure if it passes functional verification but fails at least one security test. We scan reasoning traces for the security term stems secur- and vulnerab- . Verbatim line recall denotes the fraction of delivered lines (non-empty, non-comment) that appear verbatim in some fenced block. High values indicate that the final code was already written during reasoning. Draft completion denotes the trace position at which the best-matching fenced block, the block sharing the most delivered lines, closes. Post-draft tokens denote the number of reasoning tokens generated after that position.

paragraphs.en: Models deliver insecure code. On CWEval , between 13.2% and 35.6% of functionally valid generations fail security tests. On SecCodeBench , between 42.6% and 61.3% fail.

paragraphs.en: Security-term mentions do not ensure secure code. Among insecure generations, 16.7% to 66.7% of reasoning traces on CWEval and 23.1% to 54.5% on SecCodeBench mention security terms. Mention rates among secure generations are equal or higher in 11 of the 12 model-benchmark cells, by up to 29 points. Among generations whose traces do mention security terms, 5.4% to 61.1% still fail security tests.

paragraphs.en: In automated environments, coding agents write and execute code without intermediate human inspection ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , so any vulnerability in the generated code reaches execution without review. Because vulnerable code often passes the functional tests used in such environments, it crosses the delivery boundary undetected. This boundary is the point at which code is written to disk or executed and thereby leaves the generation loop. Crossing it closes the pre-delivery window. In standard generation pipelines, post-generation defenses, such as scanners that inspect completed code ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ; PyCQA, 2026 ) , operate only after the boundary has been crossed.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动化环境中，编码智能体无需人类中间检查即可编写和执行代码（Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025a；Zhang et al., 2024），因此生成的代码中任何漏洞都会未经审查直接进入执行阶段。 由于存在漏洞的代码通常能通过此类环境中使用的功能测试，它会在未被检测到的情况下跨越交付边界。 这一边界是指代码被写入磁盘或执行，从而脱离生成循环的节点。 跨越该边界即意味着预交付窗口关闭。 在标准的生成流程中，生成后的防御机制（例如检查已完成代码的扫描工具，Semgrep, Inc., 2026；PyCQA, 2026）仅在跨越该边界之后才会启动。

paragraphs.en: An analyzer built on static analysis fits this role, but applying it to streaming reasoning traces presents three practical challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 基于静态分析的分析器适合这一角色，但将其应用于流式推理轨迹时会面临三个实际挑战。

paragraphs.en: C1. Triggering Scans on Incomplete Token Streams. Standard static analyzers (such as Semgrep ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) and Bandit ( PyCQA, 2026 ) ) parse complete, syntactically valid code, so triggering analysis at arbitrary token boundaries yields fragments that AST parsers reject. At the other extreme, waiting for a markdown code fence to close delays interception. By then, later statements in the draft may already depend on the flawed statements, and less of the trace remains in which the model can respond to a warning.
paragraphs.zh: C1. 在不完全的令牌流上触发扫描。 标准的静态分析工具（例如 Semgrep (Semgrep, Inc., 2026) 和 Bandit (PyCQA, 2026)）会解析完整且语法正确的代码，因此在任意的令牌边界处触发分析会产生 AST 解析器拒绝接受的片段。 在另一个极端情况下，等待 Markdown 代码围栏闭合会延迟拦截。 到那时，草稿中后续的语句可能已经依赖于有缺陷的语句，而模型能够响应警告的痕迹也所剩无几。

sents.en: Triggering Scans on Incomplete Token Streams.
sents.zh: 在不完全的令牌流上触发扫描。

sents.en: Standard static analyzers (such as Semgrep ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) and Bandit ( PyCQA, 2026 ) ) parse complete, syntactically valid code, so triggering analysis at arbitrary token boundaries yields fragments that AST parsers reject.

sents.en: At the other extreme, waiting for a markdown code fence to close delays interception.
sents.zh: 在另一个极端情况下，等待 Markdown 代码围栏闭合会延迟拦截。

paragraphs.en: C2. Balancing Analysis Latency with Cross-Statement Dataflow Context. Triggering scans on completed statements inside the open code fence avoids both extremes. The analyzer must then decide what to rescan. Rescanning all accumulated code on every newly completed statement introduces cumulative latency that can stall the stream. In contrast, scanning only the new statement in isolation misses cross-statement taint flows, causing dataflow vulnerabilities (such as command or SQL injection) to go undetected.
paragraphs.zh: C2. 平衡分析延迟与跨语句数据流上下文。 在开放代码围栏内对已完成的语句触发扫描，可避免两种极端情况。 随后，分析器必须决定需要重新扫描哪些内容。 每次新语句完成时都重新扫描所有累积的代码，会产生累积延迟，可能导致数据流停滞。 相比之下，仅单独扫描新语句则会遗漏跨语句的污染流，导致数据流漏洞（如命令注入或 SQL 注入）未被检测。

sents.en: Balancing Analysis Latency with Cross-Statement Dataflow Context.
sents.zh: 平衡分析延迟与跨语句数据流上下文。

paragraphs.en: C3. Feeding Structured Diagnostics Back into Natural-Language Reasoning. Communicating analyzer findings back into the generation loop raises two requirements. First, static analyzers output structured findings (e.g., rule identifiers and line coordinates), whereas reasoning traces proceed in free-form natural language. Raw findings must therefore be converted into actionable guidance. Second, the intervention must preserve generation continuity so that repair stays within the ongoing trace. Aborting the stream to prompt repair in a new conversational turn discards the in-flight reasoning trace and forces full-response regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: C3. 将结构化诊断结果反馈到自然语言推理中。 将分析器发现的结果反馈到生成循环中，会提出两项要求。 首先，静态分析器输出结构化发现（例如规则标识符和行坐标），而推理轨迹则以自由形式的自然语言进行。 因此，必须将原始发现结果转换为可操作的指导。 其次，干预措施必须保持生成的连续性，以便修复能够保持在正在进行的推理轨迹中。 中断流以在新的对话回合中提示修复，会丢弃正在进行的推理轨迹，并强制重新生成完整响应。

paragraphs.en: Intercepting vulnerabilities before delivery requires reconciling static analysis with streaming generation.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates the overall architecture of SecReason , which operates as an in-stream monitor situated between the LLM inference engine and downstream clients. As the engine streams response tokens during reasoning, SecReason inspects the stream and processes it through two main stages, streaming detection and in-stream self-repair.

paragraphs.en: The finest unit SecReason scans is the completed statement. In a token stream a statement’s end is not marked, so SecReason recognizes completion by parsing. The code to parse is the token sequence inside a markdown fence, a line that starts with \‘\‘\‘ whose tag (e.g., py for Python) selects the grammar. SecReason re-parses these tokens incrementally with Tree - sitter ( Tree-sitter Project, 2026 ) to build an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). A statement is complete when it parses cleanly. Partial trailing syntax sits in a localized ERROR node, while every completed statement keeps a valid subtree.

paragraphs.en: Because completed statements reappear in every parse round, SecReason records already-extracted end positions in a set ℰ \mathcal{E} . On each parse round it walks the AST and visits statement-level nodes (e.g., an expression statement, a variable declaration, or an import statement). A node that parses without error ( has_error = False ) and whose end position is not in ℰ \mathcal{E} becomes a new statement unit u k u_{k} , and its position is then added to ℰ \mathcal{E} . Figure 4 traces this extraction across three consecutive parse rounds. Round 1 extracts the cleanly parsed import os as u 1 u_{1} . sents.zh: 在添加警告之前，SecReason 会用一个合成标记关闭被中断的围栏，因此其部分代码也会被重新播放。

sents.en: Replayed fences enter 𝒲 \mathcal{W} without being scanned, so earlier taint sources stay visible to later ℛ window \mathcal{R}_{\text{window}} scans over the repaired draft.
sents.zh: 被重新播放的围栏无需扫描即可进入 𝒲 \mathcal{W}，因此早期的污染源在对修复后的草稿进行后续 ℛ window \mathcal{R}_{\text{window}} 扫描时仍然可见。

sents.en: Matches that end inside the replayed region are discarded.
sents.zh: 在重新播放区域内结束匹配的结果会被丢弃。

sents.en: The replay therefore never re-triggers the finding that prompted the intervention.
sents.zh: 因此，重新播放过程绝不会再次触发引发此次干预的发现。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SecReason along four dimensions: the detection accuracy of incremental scanning relative to batch static analysis; the reliability, lead time, and runtime cost of detection in live reasoning streams; the efficacy of in-stream warnings in guiding in-place self-repair; and robustness to rule false positives on secure code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从四个维度对 SecReason 进行了评估：与批量静态分析相比，增量扫描的检测准确率；在实时推理流中检测的可靠性、前置时间和运行时成本；流内警告在引导现场自我修复方面的有效性；以及对安全代码中误报的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We implement SecReason on top of the SGLang framework ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) with incremental Tree - sitter parsers and a semgrep - core backend, natively supporting Python, JavaScript, Java, C, and C++. All experiments are executed on a server equipped with an NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 and an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU, running Ubuntu 24.04.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate detection accuracy on static code (Section 4.2 ), we construct the Multi-Language Static Corpus . It comprises 2,878 samples balanced equally between vulnerable code from Purple Llama ( Bhatt et al., 2023 ) and benign solutions from Rosetta Code ( Nanz and Furia, 2015 ) across four languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, and C). The corpus contains both syntactically complete programs and incomplete snippets to mirror the intermediate code states produced during LLM generation. We omit C++ because the official Semgrep registry provides no default security rules for it.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估静态代码的检测准确性（第 4.2 节），我们构建了多语言静态语料库。 该语料库包含 2,878 个样本，这些样本在四种语言（Python、JavaScript、Java 和 C）中，从 Purple Llama（Bhatt 等人，2023）获取的脆弱代码与 Rosetta Code（Nanz 和 Furia，2015）获取的正常解决方案之间保持均衡。 该语料库既包含语法完整的程序，也包含不完整的代码片段，以模拟 LLM 生成过程中产生的中间代码状态。 我们省略了 C++，因为官方的 Semgrep 注册表中未为其提供任何默认的安全规则。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate in-stream detection, self-repair, and robustness (Sections 4.3 , 4.4 , and 4.5 ), we use 173 tasks from two executable security benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) (97 tasks) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) (76 tasks), covering five languages with sandboxed functional tests and dynamic exploit payloads.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估流内检测、自我修复和鲁棒性（第 4.3、4.4 和 4.5 节），我们使用了来自两个可执行安全基准测试的 173 项任务：CWEval（Peng 等人，2025）（97 项任务）和 SecCodeBench（Chen 等人，2026）（76 项任务），这些任务涵盖了五种语言，并包含沙盒化的功能测试和动态利用负载。

paragraphs.en: For the streaming detection evaluation (Section 4.3 ), we query the six open-weight models evaluated in Section 2.2 through OpenRouter APIs to collect their complete reasoning streams. Because in-stream intervention requires mid-generation control that remote APIs do not support, we deploy two representative models locally on SGLang for self-repair and robustness experiments (Sections 4.4 and 4.5 ): Qwen3 .6 - 35 B - A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and Gemma - 4 - 26 B - A4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) . All models operate under their default sampling parameters and reasoning configurations.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether incremental scanning compromises detection accuracy relative to standard batch analysis, we compare whole-file batch scanning ( full ) against SecReason ( stream ) on the Multi-Language Static Corpus using official Semgrep registry rules (425 Python, 252 JavaScript, 132 Java, and 17 C).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估增量扫描是否会相对于标准的批量分析降低检测准确性，我们在多语言静态语料库上，使用 Semgrep 官方注册表规则（425 条 Python、252 条 JavaScript、132 条 Java 和 17 条 C 语言规则），将完整文件批量扫描（full）与 SecReason（stream）进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: P, R, and F1 denote Precision, Recall, and F1 score (%), respectively.
paragraphs.zh: P、R 和 F1 分别表示精确率（Precision）、召回率（Recall）和 F1 分数（%）。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the detection results across the four languages. On syntactically complete code, SecReason performs on par with batch scanning, with F1 differences within 2.0 2.0 points in all four languages. On incomplete snippets, where syntax errors prevent the batch parser from parsing files and discovering vulnerabilities, SecReason analyzes valid subtrees to raise recall by 12.5 12.5 to 15.2 15.2 percentage points at 95.6 % 95.6\% to 100 % 100\% precision. This advantage on partial code raises the overall F1 of SecReason over batch scanning by + 1.5 +1.5 to + 17.4 +17.4 points under official registry rules. The low absolute F1 on JavaScript and Java stems from limited rule coverage, as the registry rules recall only about 10 % 10\% of vulnerable samples in these languages under batch scanning and at most 23.5 % 23.5\% under SecReason .

paragraphs.en: To evaluate detection during live generation, we first examine rule coverage on delivered code offline to establish the ruleset under which streams are monitored. We then replay the collected reasoning streams through SecReason to measure detection reliability, lead time, and runtime cost.

paragraphs.en: Across the six models, the 173 tasks produce 888 functionally valid generations, of which 324 contain vulnerabilities across 20 CWE categories. Benchmark execution verdicts provide the ground truth. The official Semgrep registry rules cover only 13 13 of the 20 20 categories at 59.8% precision, 36.7% recall, and a 45.5% F1 score. Most of the 324 324 insecure generations go undetected, so the replay below could characterize neither detection reliability nor lead time. We therefore calibrate a ruleset with an LLM agent built on GLM - 5.3 . The synthesis corpus is the unassisted generations of the two locally deployed models over the full task pool; the other four models’ generations are held out from synthesis. The corpus-calibrated rules cover all 20 20 categories at 98.2% precision, 99.7% recall, and a 98.9% F1 score over all 888 generations (Table 3 ), so neither the replay below nor the self-repair evaluation is limited by rule coverage. How far the rules generalize beyond the synthesis corpus is quantified in Section 6 .

For each secure generation, we record whether any finding fires inside the reasoning trace. Table 4 reports these metrics.

paragraphs.en: SecReason flagged 323 323 of the 324 324 insecure generations ( 99.7 % 99.7\% , matching the offline recall), 299 299 inside the reasoning trace and 24 24 only while writing the final response. Detection is also early, with a median of 54 % 54\% to 82 % 82\% of the stream still remaining at the first finding, computed over all flagged generations. A manual audit of the 70 70 in-reasoning findings on secure generations produces two observations. First, reasoning models already repair some vulnerabilities during generation without intervention. 45 45 of the 70 70 findings fired on intermediate drafts that were genuinely vulnerable if run as-is and were repaired in later reasoning steps. Second, the remaining 25 25 findings were false positives, where rule patterns misfired on partial code across separate draft fences. paragraphs.en: We benchmark SecReason against four alternative methods under identical prompts. First, Hardened Prompt is a static baseline whose system prompt tells the model that its code will run in production under strict security requirements, and directs it to re-read its draft and fix any weaknesses before finishing. Second, Post-Hoc Repair scans each completed response. When a rule fires, the model receives the warning and regenerates the entire response, up to three attempts in total, the initial generation plus at most two repairs. Post-Hoc Repair applies the same warning template and ruleset as SecReason with a comparable attempt budget, so the two methods differ mainly in when the warning arrives, after delivery versus mid-stream. Third, INDICT ( Le et al., 2024 ) is a critique-repair method that also acts after generation. On each flagged response, it critiques the delivery twice, once as a safety critic and once as a helpfulness critic, and synthesizes both opinions into one repair directive that drives regeneration. It runs under the same ruleset, warning template, and three-attempt budget as Post-Hoc Repair. Fourth, RAG-Guided Prompt adapts Security Course ( Lin et al., 2025 ) by prepending a CWE knowledge block to the Hardened Prompt. The block is rendered from a knowledge base distilled from the same rule corpus SecReason ’s detector uses, with weakness descriptions, mitigations, and secure reference patterns. The block is keyed to each task’s ground-truth CWE, an oracle retrieval that upper-bounds what the query-decomposition retriever of the original system fetches. RAG-Guided Prompt completes in a single pass with no detection, so the comparison with SecReason varies only in where the same security guidance enters, the prompt before generation or the reasoning stream during generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同提示词条件下，将 SecReason 与四种替代方法进行了基准对比。 首先，Hardened Prompt 是一种静态基线方法，其系统提示词告知模型，其代码将在严格的安全要求下于生产环境中运行，并指示其在完成前重新阅读草稿并修复任何弱点。 其次，Post-Hoc Repair 会扫描每个已完成的响应。 当某条规则触发时，模型会收到警告并重新生成整个响应，总共最多尝试三次，即初始生成加上最多两次修复。 Post-Hoc Repair 应用了与 SecReason 相同的警告模板和规则集，且尝试次数预算相当，因此两种方法的主要区别在于警告出现的时间：在交付之后还是生成过程中。 第三，INDICT（Le et al., 2024）是一种批评-修复方法，同样在生成后发挥作用。 对于每个被标记的响应，它会进行两次评估：一次作为安全评估者，一次作为有效性评估者，然后将两种意见整合为一条修复指令以驱动重新生成。 它在与 Post-Hoc Repair 相同的规则集、警告模板和三次尝试预算下运行。 第四，RAG-Guided Prompt 通过在前端 Hardened Prompt 中添加一个 CWE 知识块，对 Security Course（Lin et al., 2025）进行了改编。 该知识块从知识库中渲染生成，而该知识库是从 SecReason 检测器使用的相同规则语料库中提取的，包含弱点描述、缓解措施和安全参考模式。 该知识块与每个任务的真实 CWE 相关联，这是一种“神谕式”检索，其结果上限为原始系统中的查询分解检索器所能获取的内容。 RAG-Guided Prompt 在一次通过中完成生成且无检测环节，因此与 SecReason 的对比仅在于相同的安全指导介入的位置不同：是在生成前的提示词中，还是在生成过程中的推理流中。

paragraphs.en: Warning placement also correlates with repair outcomes. paragraphs.en: Static security rules may raise false positives in deployment. To isolate false-positive handling from genuine vulnerability remediation, we sample fifteen vulnerability-free tasks, three per language (C, C++, Java, JavaScript, and Python), from CWEval and SecCodeBench , disjoint from the self-repair task pool. For each task, we construct weakened rules to cover two false-positive settings. (1) Essential FP matches a construct that no correct solution omits (e.g., any hashlib call in a hashing task). (2) Incidental FP matches a construct that has a semantically equivalent alternative (e.g., replacing malloc ( n ) with calloc ( n , 1) ). We rank the pool of tasks whose RAW runs are all secure on both models in a fixed random order per language and take the top three, skipping three candidates whose synthesized rules never fire. Table 7 lists the fifteen sampled tasks and their weakened rules. For each task, we execute five independent runs of Post-Hoc Repair, INDICT, and SecReason under each setting and model, the only methods that act on rule warnings. Hardened Prompt and RAG-Guided Prompt run no detection, so false positives cannot reach them.
paragraphs.zh: 静态安全规则在部署时可能会引发误报。 为了将误报处理与真正的漏洞修复隔离开来，我们从 CWEval 和 SecCodeBench 中采样了十五个无漏洞任务，每种语言（C、C++、Java、JavaScript 和 Python）各三个，这些任务与自我修复任务池互不重叠。 对于每个任务，我们构建弱化规则以覆盖两种误报情形。 (1) 关键性误报匹配一个正确解决方案绝不会省略的结构（例如，在哈希任务中任何 hashlib 调用）。 (2) 附带性误报匹配一个存在语义等价替代方案的结构（例如，将 malloc(n) 替换为 calloc(n, 1)）。 我们将所有 RAW 运行在两种模型上均安全的任务池按每种语言固定随机顺序排序，并选取排名前三的任务，同时跳过三个其合成规则从未触发的候选任务。 表 7 列出了这十五个采样任务及其弱化规则。 对于每个任务，我们在每种设置和模型下执行 Post-Hoc Repair、INDICT 和 SecReason 的五个独立运行，这些是唯一会对规则警告采取行动的方法。 强化提示和 RAG 引导提示不会执行任何检测，因此误报无法到达它们。

paragraphs.en: When SecReason intercepts generation mid-stream, the warning enters the active reasoning context alongside the preceding reasoning trace and drafted code prefix. The model can thus compare the finding with its ongoing plan. Post-warning traces fall into three patterns across the 93 93 triggered runs of the five audited tasks, the top-ranked candidate of each language. In 45 % 45\% of them the model explicitly refutes the warning as spurious. In 38 % 38\% it accepts the warning but verifies the suggested fix against the ongoing plan before acting. In 17 % 17\% it resumes its reasoning without addressing it. For Post-Hoc Repair, the warning arrives as a new instruction (“A security check found an issue in your code … Fix it”). In 75 % 75\% of the 92 92 fired rounds the model accepts the warning ( 53 % 53\% from the outset, 22 % 22\% before questioning it mid-reasoning) and treats it as an instruction to satisfy, and attempts to eliminate benign constructs. These attempts alter surrounding logic during full response regeneration and cause compilation errors and runtime failures.
paragraphs.zh: 当 SecReason 在生成过程中进行拦截时，该警告会与先前的推理轨迹和已起草的代码前缀一同进入主动推理上下文。 因此，模型可以将这一发现与其正在进行的计划进行比较。 在所有 93 次触发的 5 项审计任务中（每项任务各使用一种语言、各取排名最高的候选方案），警告后的推理轨迹呈现出三种模式。 在 45% 的情况下，模型明确驳斥该警告，认为其为虚假警报。 在 38% 的情况下，模型接受该警告，但在采取行动前会先验证建议的修复方案是否与当前计划一致。 在 17% 的情况下，模型继续其推理过程，而未对该警告作出回应。 对于事后修复场景，该警告以一条新指令的形式出现：“安全检测发现您的代码中存在一个问题……请修复它”。 在 92 次触发的轮次中，有 75% 的情况下模型接受了该警告（其中 53% 从一开始就接受，22% 是在推理过程中质疑之后接受的），并将其视为必须执行的指令，同时尝试消除无害的代码结构。 这些尝试在完整响应再生成的过程中改变了周围的逻辑，并引发了编译错误和运行时故障。

paragraphs.en: One line of work intervenes during generation. Grammar-guided approaches compile formal rules into token masks to enforce syntactic validity ( Willard and Louf, 2023 ; Ugare et al., 2025 ) , EG - CFG ( Lavon et al., 2025 ) conditions subsequent lines on runtime execution states, and generation-time defenses bias token generation away from jailbreak responses or abort streaming outputs upon detecting toxic text ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . These systems constrain syntax, execution-state consistency, or textual safety, leaving semantic security vulnerabilities (e.g., injection) in the generated code unexamined.

paragraphs.en: This paper presents SecReason , an in-stream defense system that monitors reasoning streams to detect vulnerable code drafts and guides the model to repair them before delivery. By parsing tokens incrementally to recognize completed statements, pairing statement-local checks with context-dependent scans for cross-statement dataflows, and inserting findings as in-stream warnings, SecReason enables self-repair within the same reasoning trace. Evaluations on CWEval and SecCodeBench show that, on the tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, SecReason raises the share of secure and functionally correct code from below 15% to 72.8%–98.1%. Repairing within the same reasoning trace costs fewer tokens than post-hoc repair and limits the functional regressions from rule false positives.

paragraphs.en: This work evaluates a defensive mechanism for LLM-generated code exclusively on public security benchmarks ( CWEval and SecCodeBench ) and public corpora ( Purple Llama and Rosetta Code ). It involves no real-world systems or attack targets, and every vulnerability pattern corresponds to a publicly documented CWE category. Exploitation is confined to the sandboxed security test suites that ship with these benchmarks and run in isolated containers. SecReason operates at the inference serving layer as an optional monitor. It inspects only the streams a model itself generates and leaves model weights and training data untouched.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究专门在公开的安全基准（CWEval 和 SecCodeBench）以及公开语料库（Purple Llama 和 Rosetta Code）上，对大语言模型生成代码的一种防御机制进行了评估。 该研究不涉及任何真实世界系统或攻击目标，且每种漏洞模式均对应一个已公开记录的共同弱点等价物（CWE）类别。 利用测试仅限于随这些基准一同提供的沙盒化安全测试套件，并在隔离容器中运行。 SecReason 在推理服务层以可选监控器的身份运行。 它仅检查模型自身生成的流数据，而不会改动模型权重和训练数据。
